# WompLand brands

WompLand is a family of small, self-hosted publishing apps. The master brand is WompLand; each app is a "Womp" named `<job>Womp` (blogWomp, wikiWomp, …). Every brand is an icon built from three modules (a square cell, a quarter ring and a filled quarter circle) on a 7 × 7 field inside a 9 × 9 tile, on one color from a shared palette, beside its name in Archivo 600.

Each brand's guide lists its logo files, colors, DaisyUI themes and contrast checks. Every file is generated from the brand's data.

## The family

| Brand | Role | Field color | Glyph | Themes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [WompLand](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/guide.md) | Master brand | Rose `#C5547C` | pale | `wompland-wompland-light`, `wompland-wompland-dark` |
| [blogWomp](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/guide.md) | Womp | Vermilion `#CA5843` | pale | `wompland-blogwomp-light`, `wompland-blogwomp-dark` |
| [riverWomp](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/riverwomp/guide.md) | Womp | Cornflower `#477ED8` | pale | `wompland-riverwomp-light`, `wompland-riverwomp-dark` |
| [wikiWomp](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/guide.md) | Womp | Teal `#00948C` | pale | `wompland-wikiwomp-light`, `wompland-wikiwomp-dark` |

## More

- [How to apply a brand in a project](https://brand.wompland.com/usage.md)
- [The brand system: modules, lockups, palette rules, don'ts, type](https://brand.wompland.com/toolkit/system.md)
- Machine-readable: [https://brand.wompland.com/brands/index.json](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/index.json)

# How to apply a WompLand brand

Take the generated files from the brand's guide; never redraw, recolor or re-typeset the logo. Each brand's files live under `https://brand.wompland.com/brands/<slug>/` (for example https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/horizontal.svg), and its guide is `https://brand.wompland.com/brands/<slug>/guide.md`. The examples below use blogWomp; swap in the slug of your brand.

**Favicons** in `<head>`:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

**Web app manifest** (`site.webmanifest`, linked with `<link rel="manifest" href="/site.webmanifest">`). `theme_color` is the brand's `colors.field` from `brand.json` (a surface, so it is allowed there):

```json
{
  "name": "blogWomp",
  "short_name": "blogWomp",
  "start_url": "/",
  "display": "standalone",
  "theme_color": "#CA5843",
  "background_color": "#FFFFFF",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "/icon-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
    { "src": "/icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" }
  ]
}
```

**Setup** (Vite + Tailwind v4 + DaisyUI 5; the same versions this toolkit uses):

```sh
npm i -D vite tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite daisyui
npm i @fontsource/archivo
npm i @fontsource/jetbrains-mono   # only if the page shows code
```

```js
// vite.config.js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
export default defineConfig({ plugins: [tailwindcss()] });
```

**Theme and type.** Copy `daisyui-theme.css` next to the main stylesheet, then:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@plugin "daisyui" { themes: false; }
@import "./daisyui-theme.css";
@import "@fontsource/archivo/400.css";
@import "@fontsource/archivo/600.css";
@import "@fontsource/archivo/700.css";
@import "@fontsource/archivo/800.css";
@import "@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/400.css"; /* only if the page shows code */

@theme {
  --font-sans: "Archivo", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  /* The WompLand type scale as Tailwind utilities: text-label, text-small, text-body, text-h3, text-h2, text-h1, text-display. */
  --text-label: 0.8125rem;   --text-label--line-height: 1.3;
  --text-small: 0.9375rem;   --text-small--line-height: 1.5;
  --text-body: 1.125rem;     --text-body--line-height: 1.6;
  --text-h3: 1.375rem;       --text-h3--line-height: 1.1;
  --text-h2: 1.75rem;        --text-h2--line-height: 1.1;
  --text-h1: 2.5rem;         --text-h1--line-height: 1.1;
  --text-display: 4rem;      --text-display--line-height: 0.98;
}
```

Leave the root font size alone (16px), so DaisyUI components keep their normal size; set reading text with `text-body` on `<body>` or the content column.

Theme names are `wompland-<slug>-light` and `wompland-<slug>-dark`. The light theme is the default; the dark theme is marked `prefersdark`, so DaisyUI applies it when the visitor's OS prefers dark. `data-theme="wompland-<slug>-light|dark"` on `<html>` overrides both. Without Tailwind/DaisyUI, read the hex values from `brand.json` → `tokens` and the CSS file, and map them to the project's own variables.

What the theme gives you: base colors (white / graphite grounds, near-black ink), `primary` (the brand color made safe for text and buttons), secondary/accent/status colors, square corners (radius 0), 2px borders, no shadows, plus three custom properties:

- `--muted`: secondary text (captions, metadata, "last edited"). In Tailwind: `text-[var(--muted)]`. It passes 4.5:1 on `base-100` and `base-200`.
- `--field`, `--field-glyph`: the brand's tile colors, for decorative bands only (`bg-[var(--field)] text-[var(--field-glyph)]` on a band with large, bold text). Never small text.

Every theme passes WCAG 2.2 AA, with body text at 7:1 or more, and `primary` / `primary-content` and every other color / `-content` pair pass 4.5:1. Keep that: use `base-content` on `base-*` for text, `primary` for links and primary buttons, and each color's `-content` partner for text on it.

**Type.** Archivo for all interface and reading text; JetBrains Mono only for code. Headings weight 700 with tight tracking (`tracking-tight`); display weight 800. Labels are `text-label`, weight 600, uppercase, `tracking-wider`. Nothing below 13px.

**House style for common parts:**

- Links: `primary`, underlined (`link link-primary`).
- Neutral outline buttons: `btn btn-outline border-base-content` (DaisyUI's default outline border fades out in the dark theme).
- Code blocks: `bg-base-200`, a 2px `base-content` border, `font-mono text-small`, no rounded corners.
- Panels and cards: square, 2px `base-content` border or a `base-200` fill; no shadows. Rules between sections are 2–3px `base-content`.
- Current item in a nav or page tree: bold plus `aria-current="page"`, never color alone.

**A dark band on a light page** (footer, feature strip): put `data-theme="wompland-<slug>-dark"` on that element; themes nest. Use `bg-base-100` or `bg-base-200` inside it and the `-reverse` logo.

**Logo in the header:** `<img src="/horizontal.svg" alt="blogWomp" class="h-8 w-auto">`. Size it with a class: Tailwind's base styles set `img { height: auto }`, which overrides a `height="32"` attribute. The `alt` is the brand name. On a dark ground use `horizontal-reverse.svg`. When the page has both themes, show the file that matches the theme:

- Theme follows the OS only: `<picture><source srcset="/horizontal-reverse.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)"><img src="/horizontal.svg" alt="blogWomp" class="h-8 w-auto"></picture>`.
- The site has its own light/dark switch (`data-theme`), which `<picture>` cannot see. Render both images, both with the real `alt` (the hidden one is `display: none`, so screen readers skip it), and let CSS pick. This also works inside a nested dark band:

  ```html
  <img class="logo-light h-8 w-auto" src="/horizontal.svg" alt="blogWomp">
  <img class="logo-dark h-8 w-auto" src="/horizontal-reverse.svg" alt="blogWomp">
  ```

  ```css
  .logo-dark { display: none; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme$="-light"]) .logo-light { display: none; }
    :root:not([data-theme$="-light"]) .logo-dark { display: inline; }
  }
  [data-theme$="-dark"] .logo-light { display: none; }
  [data-theme$="-dark"] .logo-dark { display: inline; }
  ```

**A light/dark switch** that overrides the OS and is remembered. In `<head>`, before the stylesheet, so there is no flash of the wrong theme:

```html
<script>
  try { var m = localStorage.getItem('theme'); if (m === 'light' || m === 'dark') document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'wompland-blogwomp-' + m; } catch (e) {}
</script>
```

The button (`<button type="button" id="mode" aria-pressed="false">Dark mode</button>`):

```js
const root = document.documentElement;
const btn = document.getElementById('mode');
const dark = () => root.dataset.theme ? root.dataset.theme.endsWith('-dark') : matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
const sync = () => { btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(dark())); btn.textContent = dark() ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode'; };
btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const m = dark() ? 'light' : 'dark';
  root.dataset.theme = `wompland-blogwomp-${m}`;
  try { localStorage.setItem('theme', m); } catch (e) {}
  sync();
});
sync();
```

**The name in running text** is written exactly as the brand's `name`: camelCase `blogWomp`, `WompLand`. Never `Blogwomp`, `BlogWomp`, `blog womp`.

## Rules

These come from the brand system; they are the ones most often broken.

- **Use the files as they are.** Don't redraw, recolor, stretch, rotate, flip, outline or add effects (shadows, gradients, rounded corners) to the tile or the logo. Don't put the icon inside a circle or ring.
- **Never rebuild the name.** Don't set "blogWomp" in a font next to `mark.svg` to fake a lockup; use `horizontal.svg` or `stacked.svg`.
- **Ground decides the file.** Light ground: `horizontal.svg` / `stacked.svg`. Dark ground: the `-reverse` versions. The tile itself never changes.
- **Clear space:** keep 2 modules empty on every side of a lockup. A module is 1/9 of the tile's height: for a 32px-tall horizontal logo, that is about 7px. Padding counts as clear space; other elements (nav links, text, borders) must not come closer.
- **Minimum sizes:** horizontal lockup 120px wide (30 mm in print); stacked 72px wide (20 mm); tile 24px (8 mm). Below 24px, use `favicon.svg` / the PNG favicons, not `mark.svg`.
- **The field color is a surface, never text.** `colors.field` (e.g. blogWomp's `#CA5843`) is for the tile and decorative bands only; it does not pass contrast as text. Text and links in the brand color use the theme's `primary`.
- **No colors from outside the family.** Brand color comes only from `brand.json` / the theme. One brand per app: don't mix another Womp's color into it.
- **Never blue plus a W.** A blue brand (Cornflower) is fine, but a W, letter or circled mark on blue reads as WordPress. Don't add blue accents from outside the theme.

## Check your work

- Favicon shows at 16px in a browser tab and the tile reads as the same icon as the logo.
- Header logo is the right file for the ground, not stretched, with clear space.
- Both themes load: toggle `data-theme` between `wompland-<slug>-light` and `-dark`.
- No hard-coded brand hex values in text styles; text uses theme tokens.

---

# The WompLand brand system

WompLand is a family of small, self-hosted publishing apps. The master brand is WompLand; each app is a "Womp" named `<job>Womp` (blogWomp, wikiWomp, …). Every brand is an icon built from three modules (a square cell, a quarter ring and a filled quarter circle) on a 7 × 7 field inside a 9 × 9 tile, on one color from a shared palette, beside its name in Archivo 600.

## The module kit

One module is one ninth of the tile. Every curve is exactly one module thick, so rings and stems carry the same stroke. Coordinates are on the 7 × 7 field, origin top-left.

- **Cell**: 1 × 1. Dots, caps, bars and stems.
- **Quarter ring**: size 2 to 4. A quarter band, outer radius = size, inner radius = size − 1; always one module thick.
- **Filled quarter**: size 1 to 4. A solid quarter disc that rounds a corner of a block.

`rot` names the corner of the shape's box that holds the circle's centre, clockwise from top-left: 0 top-left, 1 top-right, 2 bottom-right, 3 bottom-left.

Stems, half rings, half discs and rounded blocks are not modules of their own: they are cells and quarters placed side by side, and shapes union into one glyph.

## The icon's construction

Like every Womp, WompLand is marked by an icon, not a letter: a picture built from the module kit on the 7 × 7 field inside a one-module margin, with every stroke one module thick. WompLand: Rose field, pale glyph. Nothing is drawn freehand.

| Module | Count |
|---|---|
| Cell | 14 |
| Quarter ring, size 2, rot 2 | 1 |
| Quarter ring, size 2, rot 3 | 1 |
| Quarter ring, size 2, rot 1 | 1 |
| Quarter ring, size 2, rot 0 | 1 |

## The lockup spec

A lockup is the tile plus the name in Archivo 600, measured in modules of the tile (u = 1/9 of the tile).

- **Horizontal**: the name starts 3u from the tile; its caps are 5u tall and centred on the tile.
- **Stacked**: the tile is centred over the name, 2u from the tile to the cap top.
- Tracking -0.01em. Names are camelCase as written (`<job>` + Womp), and outlined in every logo file, so no file depends on the font.
- The tile never changes between grounds; only the name switches from ink (light grounds) to paper (dark grounds, the `-reverse` files).
- **Clear space**: 2u on every side.
- **Minimum sizes**:

| Use | Screen | Print |
|---|---|---|
| Horizontal lockup | 120 px | 30 mm |
| Stacked lockup | 72 px | 20 mm |
| Tile, full art | 24 px | 8 mm |
| Tile, favicon art | 16 px | — |

Below 24 px, use the favicon art: a 1 px margin instead of one module, snapped to whole pixels.

## One rule for every Womp

A Womp's glyph is the core object of its job, built from the module kit inside the 7 × 7 field, set on one palette color with that color's pale or deep partner, and followed by its name in Archivo 600. No new design work per app: pick the object the app is about, draw it, choose a color. The theme follows from the color.

- **blogWomp**: Vermilion field, pale glyph. A feed: the newest post is the big block with the rounded corner; older posts are bars. [Guide](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/guide.md)
- **riverWomp**: Cornflower field, pale glyph. A river of news: headlines flow down the page, newest first, in batches by source. Each dot starts a new source; the bars beside and below it are its headlines. [Guide](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/riverwomp/guide.md)
- **wikiWomp**: Teal field, pale glyph. A link target: square brackets around a page block, the way a wiki link wraps the page it points to. [Guide](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/guide.md)

## The palette rules

1. **Equal weight.** Every field sits in one lightness band (OKLCH L 0.56 to 0.62), so no Womp shouts over another.
2. **Works on white and graphite.** Each field reaches 3:1 against white (`#FFFFFF`) and graphite (`#1D1E20`), so the tile reads as a shape on either page.
3. **Pale and deep partners.** Each field has a pale and a deep glyph color of the same hue (within 12°), both at 3:1 or more on the field. A brand picks one.
4. **Distinct, and clear of look-alikes.** Neighbouring fields stay tellable apart, and every field keeps its distance from WordPress and Shopify colors. Blue is fine, but never blue plus a W.

### The colors

Take a brand's colors from its theme, not from this table: the theme primary is derived from the field so it reaches 4.5:1 as text.

| Color | Field | Pale | Deep | Field on white | Field on graphite | Pale on field | Deep on field | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rose | `#C5547C` | `#FFE7EE` | `#431827` | 4.26:1 | 3.92:1 | 3.63:1 | 3.53:1 | WompLand |
| Vermilion | `#CA5843` | `#FFE9E4` | `#451911` | 4.21:1 | 3.96:1 | 3.61:1 | 3.56:1 | blogWomp |
| Copper | `#BE6600` | `#FFEADB` | `#411F00` | 4.13:1 | 4.04:1 | 3.55:1 | 3.58:1 | Unused |
| Ochre | `#A37900` | `#FAEDD5` | `#362600` | 3.97:1 | 4.20:1 | 3.43:1 | 3.69:1 | Unused |
| Olive | `#888500` | `#F0F1D6` | `#2C2B00` | 3.89:1 | 4.29:1 | 3.38:1 | 3.72:1 | Unused |
| Fern | `#43963C` | `#E2F5DF` | `#11310E` | 3.71:1 | 4.50:1 | 3.24:1 | 3.86:1 | Unused |
| Jade | `#009867` | `#DBF6E7` | `#00321F` | 3.69:1 | 4.52:1 | 3.23:1 | 3.85:1 | Unused |
| Teal | `#00948C` | `#D5F7F3` | `#00302D` | 3.74:1 | 4.46:1 | 3.28:1 | 3.84:1 | wikiWomp |
| Cornflower | `#477ED8` | `#E5EFFF` | `#13284B` | 4.00:1 | 4.17:1 | 3.46:1 | 3.66:1 | riverWomp |
| Iris | `#7E6ED3` | `#EDECFF` | `#282249` | 4.15:1 | 4.02:1 | 3.57:1 | 3.57:1 | Unused |
| Violet | `#A061BE` | `#F7E8FF` | `#351D41` | 4.24:1 | 3.93:1 | 3.63:1 | 3.53:1 | Unused |
| Plum | `#B7589F` | `#FFE6F7` | `#3E1935` | 4.28:1 | 3.90:1 | 3.65:1 | 3.52:1 | Unused |

## Don'ts

- Don't put a circle or ring around the icon.
- Don't stretch the tile. It is always square.
- Don't rotate or flip it. The icon has one upright, and turned it stops reading as itself.
- Don't set the name in another face, or build it from modules.
- Don't use a color outside the palette, even a familiar one.
- Don't put a W, or any letter or circled mark, on a blue tile. Blue plus a W reads as WordPress.

## The type scale

Archivo for everything people read: one family, seven sizes, tabular figures wherever numbers line up. JetBrains Mono is for code only.

| Role | Size | Leading | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wordmark | cap 5u | — | 600 |
| Display | 64 px | 0.98 | 800 |
| Heading 1 | 40 px | 1.10 | 700 |
| Heading 2 | 28 px | 1.10 | 700 |
| Heading 3 | 22 px | 1.10 | 700 |
| Body | 18 px | 1.60 | 400 |
| Small | 15 px | 1.50 | 400 |
| Label | 13 px | 1.30 | 600 |
| Code | 14 px | 1.60 | 400 |

Reading text is 18 pixels on a 68-character measure. Headings stay tight (−2%), labels open up (+4%) and run in capitals, and nothing is set below 13 pixels.

---

# WompLand brand guide

Master brand of the WompLand family. Rose field, pale glyph. Themes `wompland-wompland-light` and `wompland-wompland-dark`.

**Icon.** A Womp: a made-up little guy.

Visual version: https://brand.wompland.com/toolkit/brand.html?brand=wompland

## Logo files

Every file is generated from the brand data. The names in the SVGs are outlined paths, so logos need no font installed.

| File | Use | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Horizontal lockup | Main logo for light grounds. Site headers. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/horizontal.svg |
| Horizontal lockup, reverse | For dark grounds; the name switches to paper, the tile is identical. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/horizontal-reverse.svg |
| Stacked lockup | Tile centred over the name, for square-ish spaces on light grounds. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/stacked.svg |
| Stacked lockup, reverse | For dark grounds. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/stacked-reverse.svg |
| Mark | The icon tile alone, 72 × 72, scales freely. Avatars, app icons in UI. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/mark.svg |
| Favicon art (SVG) | Tuned for 16–32 px. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/favicon.svg |
| favicon.ico | 16 and 32 px inside, for old browsers. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/favicon.ico |
| PNG 16 | 16 × 16, favicon art. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/icon-16.png |
| PNG 32 | 32 × 32, favicon art. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/icon-32.png |
| Apple touch icon | 180 × 180. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/apple-touch-icon.png |
| PNG 192 | 192 × 192, web app manifest. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/icon-192.png |
| PNG 512 | 512 × 512, web app manifest. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/icon-512.png |
| DaisyUI themes | Light and dark theme blocks. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/daisyui-theme.css |
| Brand data | Source, colors, theme tokens and asset paths (JSON). | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/brand.json |

## On light and dark

- Light ground: `horizontal.svg` / `stacked.svg`. Dark ground: the `-reverse` versions. The tile never changes; only the name switches from ink to paper.
- Keep 2 modules (2/9 of the tile) clear on every side.
- Minimum sizes: horizontal lockup 120 px (30 mm); stacked lockup 72 px (20 mm); tile, full art 24 px (8 mm); tile, favicon art 16 px. Below 24 px, use the favicon art.

## Colors

The tile is the Rose field with its pale partner as the glyph. Fields are surfaces: text on a field is only ever large (22px bold), because the glyph partner is gated at 3:1, which is AA for large text only. Text in the brand color uses the theme primary, which is derived from the field until it reaches 4.5:1 on both page grounds.

| Role | Hex | OKLCH |
|---|---|---|
| Field (tile background) | `#C5547C` | oklch(60.1% 0.149 0.5) |
| Pale (glyph) | `#FFE7EE` | oklch(94.9% 0.028 358.0) |
| Deep (partner) | `#431827` | oklch(28.0% 0.069 0.7) |

Theme primary:

- **Light** (`wompland-wompland-light`): primary `#B4456D`, primary-content `#FFFFFF`
- **Dark** (`wompland-wompland-dark`): primary `#DD6A91`, primary-content `#141414`

### Contrast gate

All 42 checks pass, light and dark. Body text 7:1, muted text and every color on its content 4.5:1, primary as text 4.5:1, interface colors 3:1.

| Pair | Min | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| base-content on base100 | 7 | 18.42:1 Pass | 14.12:1 Pass |
| base-content on base200 | 7 | 16.45:1 Pass | 12.68:1 Pass |
| base-content on base300 | 7 | 14.21:1 Pass | 10.87:1 Pass |
| muted on base100 | 4.5 | 7.45:1 Pass | 6.86:1 Pass |
| muted on base200 | 4.5 | 6.65:1 Pass | 6.16:1 Pass |
| primary-content on primary | 4.5 | 5.23:1 Pass | 5.74:1 Pass |
| secondary-content on secondary | 4.5 | 18.42:1 Pass | 15.59:1 Pass |
| accent-content on accent | 4.5 | 5.26:1 Pass | 10.04:1 Pass |
| neutral-content on neutral | 4.5 | 18.42:1 Pass | 15.59:1 Pass |
| info-content on info | 4.5 | 9.11:1 Pass | 10.26:1 Pass |
| success-content on success | 4.5 | 6.53:1 Pass | 8.61:1 Pass |
| warning-content on warning | 4.5 | 5.26:1 Pass | 10.04:1 Pass |
| error-content on error | 4.5 | 6.54:1 Pass | 7.28:1 Pass |
| primary on base100 | 4.5 | 5.23:1 Pass | 5.20:1 Pass |
| primary on base200 | 4.5 | 4.67:1 Pass | 4.67:1 Pass |
| secondary on base-100 | 3 | 18.42:1 Pass | 14.12:1 Pass |
| accent on base-100 | 3 | 5.26:1 Pass | 9.09:1 Pass |
| info on base-100 | 3 | 9.11:1 Pass | 9.29:1 Pass |
| success on base-100 | 3 | 6.53:1 Pass | 7.79:1 Pass |
| warning on base-100 | 3 | 5.26:1 Pass | 9.09:1 Pass |
| error on base-100 | 3 | 6.54:1 Pass | 6.59:1 Pass |

## Install

Copy the files into the project's static folder, then add the favicons to `<head>`:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

Save [`daisyui-theme.css`](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wompland/daisyui-theme.css) next to the main stylesheet and import it after DaisyUI (Tailwind v4 + DaisyUI 5):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@plugin "daisyui" { themes: false; }
@import "./daisyui-theme.css";
```

The light theme is the default; the dark theme applies when the visitor prefers dark. Set `data-theme="wompland-wompland-dark"` on `<html>` to force it. Or paste the theme blocks directly:

```css
/* WompLand DaisyUI themes, generated from brands/wompland.json. Import this file (or paste all of it) after @plugin "daisyui". */

@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "wompland-wompland-light";
  default: true;
  prefersdark: false;
  color-scheme: light;
  --color-base-100: #FFFFFF;
  --color-base-200: #F3F2EE;
  --color-base-300: #E4E2DB;
  --color-base-content: #141414;
  --color-primary: #B4456D;
  --color-primary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-secondary: #141414;
  --color-secondary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-accent: #8F6400;
  --color-accent-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral: #141414;
  --color-neutral-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-info: #3E4A52;
  --color-info-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-success: #1D6B3A;
  --color-success-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-warning: #8F6400;
  --color-warning-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-error: #B3261E;
  --color-error-content: #FFFFFF;
  --muted: #57554F;
  --radius-selector: 0rem;
  --radius-field: 0rem;
  --radius-box: 0rem;
  --size-selector: 0.25rem;
  --size-field: 0.25rem;
  --border: 2px;
  --depth: 0;
  --noise: 0;
  --field: #C5547C;
  --field-glyph: #FFE7EE;
}

  name: "wompland-wompland-dark";
  default: false;
  prefersdark: true;
  color-scheme: dark;
  --color-base-100: #1D1E20;
  --color-base-200: #25272A;

  --color-primary-content: #141414;

  --color-secondary-content: #141414;

  --color-accent-content: #141414;

/* Inactive tabs use the theme's muted color so they pass 4.5:1. */
.tabs > .tab:not(:hover, .tab-active, [aria-selected="true"], [aria-current]:not([aria-current="false"], [aria-current=""]), .tab-disabled, [disabled]) { color: var(--muted); }
```

# blogWomp brand guide

A Womp, part of the [WompLand family](https://brand.wompland.com/index.md). Vermilion field, pale glyph. Themes `wompland-blogwomp-light` and `wompland-blogwomp-dark`.

**Icon.** A feed: the newest post is the big block with the rounded corner; older posts are bars.

Visual version: https://brand.wompland.com/toolkit/brand.html?brand=blogwomp

## Logo files

Every file is generated from the brand data. The names in the SVGs are outlined paths, so logos need no font installed.

| File | Use | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Horizontal lockup | Main logo for light grounds. Site headers. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/horizontal.svg |
| Horizontal lockup, reverse | For dark grounds; the name switches to paper, the tile is identical. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/horizontal-reverse.svg |
| Stacked lockup | Tile centred over the name, for square-ish spaces on light grounds. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/stacked.svg |
| Stacked lockup, reverse | For dark grounds. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/stacked-reverse.svg |
| Mark | The icon tile alone, 72 × 72, scales freely. Avatars, app icons in UI. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/mark.svg |
| Favicon art (SVG) | Tuned for 16–32 px. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/favicon.svg |
| favicon.ico | 16 and 32 px inside, for old browsers. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/favicon.ico |
| PNG 16 | 16 × 16, favicon art. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/icon-16.png |
| PNG 32 | 32 × 32, favicon art. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/icon-32.png |
| Apple touch icon | 180 × 180. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/apple-touch-icon.png |
| PNG 192 | 192 × 192, web app manifest. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/icon-192.png |
| PNG 512 | 512 × 512, web app manifest. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/icon-512.png |
| DaisyUI themes | Light and dark theme blocks. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/daisyui-theme.css |
| Brand data | Source, colors, theme tokens and asset paths (JSON). | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/brand.json |

## On light and dark

- Light ground: `horizontal.svg` / `stacked.svg`. Dark ground: the `-reverse` versions. The tile never changes; only the name switches from ink to paper.
- Keep 2 modules (2/9 of the tile) clear on every side.
- Minimum sizes: horizontal lockup 120 px (30 mm); stacked lockup 72 px (20 mm); tile, full art 24 px (8 mm); tile, favicon art 16 px. Below 24 px, use the favicon art.

## Colors

The tile is the Vermilion field with its pale partner as the glyph. Fields are surfaces: text on a field is only ever large (22px bold), because the glyph partner is gated at 3:1, which is AA for large text only. Text in the brand color uses the theme primary, which is derived from the field until it reaches 4.5:1 on both page grounds.

| Role | Hex | OKLCH |
|---|---|---|
| Field (tile background) | `#CA5843` | oklch(60.1% 0.150 32.3) |
| Pale (glyph) | `#FFE9E4` | oklch(95.0% 0.025 32.9) |
| Deep (partner) | `#451911` | oklch(27.9% 0.070 32.2) |

Theme primary:

- **Light** (`wompland-blogwomp-light`): primary `#B94834`, primary-content `#FFFFFF`
- **Dark** (`wompland-blogwomp-dark`): primary `#E16C56`, primary-content `#141414`

### Contrast gate

All 42 checks pass, light and dark. Body text 7:1, muted text and every color on its content 4.5:1, primary as text 4.5:1, interface colors 3:1.

| Pair | Min | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| base-content on base100 | 7 | 18.42:1 Pass | 14.12:1 Pass |
| base-content on base200 | 7 | 16.45:1 Pass | 12.68:1 Pass |
| base-content on base300 | 7 | 14.21:1 Pass | 10.87:1 Pass |
| muted on base100 | 4.5 | 7.45:1 Pass | 6.86:1 Pass |
| muted on base200 | 4.5 | 6.65:1 Pass | 6.16:1 Pass |
| primary-content on primary | 4.5 | 5.20:1 Pass | 5.69:1 Pass |
| secondary-content on secondary | 4.5 | 18.42:1 Pass | 15.59:1 Pass |
| accent-content on accent | 4.5 | 5.26:1 Pass | 10.04:1 Pass |
| neutral-content on neutral | 4.5 | 18.42:1 Pass | 15.59:1 Pass |
| info-content on info | 4.5 | 9.11:1 Pass | 10.26:1 Pass |
| success-content on success | 4.5 | 6.53:1 Pass | 8.61:1 Pass |
| warning-content on warning | 4.5 | 5.26:1 Pass | 10.04:1 Pass |
| error-content on error | 4.5 | 6.54:1 Pass | 7.28:1 Pass |
| primary on base100 | 4.5 | 5.20:1 Pass | 5.15:1 Pass |
| primary on base200 | 4.5 | 4.64:1 Pass | 4.62:1 Pass |
| secondary on base-100 | 3 | 18.42:1 Pass | 14.12:1 Pass |
| accent on base-100 | 3 | 5.26:1 Pass | 9.09:1 Pass |
| info on base-100 | 3 | 9.11:1 Pass | 9.29:1 Pass |
| success on base-100 | 3 | 6.53:1 Pass | 7.79:1 Pass |
| warning on base-100 | 3 | 5.26:1 Pass | 9.09:1 Pass |
| error on base-100 | 3 | 6.54:1 Pass | 6.59:1 Pass |

## Install

Copy the files into the project's static folder, then add the favicons to `<head>`:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

Save [`daisyui-theme.css`](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/blogwomp/daisyui-theme.css) next to the main stylesheet and import it after DaisyUI (Tailwind v4 + DaisyUI 5):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@plugin "daisyui" { themes: false; }
@import "./daisyui-theme.css";
```

The light theme is the default; the dark theme applies when the visitor prefers dark. Set `data-theme="wompland-blogwomp-dark"` on `<html>` to force it. Or paste the theme blocks directly:

```css
/* blogWomp DaisyUI themes, generated from brands/blogwomp.json. Import this file (or paste all of it) after @plugin "daisyui". */

@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "wompland-blogwomp-light";
  default: true;
  prefersdark: false;
  color-scheme: light;
  --color-base-100: #FFFFFF;
  --color-base-200: #F3F2EE;
  --color-base-300: #E4E2DB;
  --color-base-content: #141414;
  --color-primary: #B94834;
  --color-primary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-secondary: #141414;
  --color-secondary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-accent: #8F6400;
  --color-accent-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral: #141414;
  --color-neutral-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-info: #3E4A52;
  --color-info-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-success: #1D6B3A;
  --color-success-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-warning: #8F6400;
  --color-warning-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-error: #B3261E;
  --color-error-content: #FFFFFF;
  --muted: #57554F;
  --radius-selector: 0rem;
  --radius-field: 0rem;
  --radius-box: 0rem;
  --size-selector: 0.25rem;
  --size-field: 0.25rem;
  --border: 2px;
  --depth: 0;
  --noise: 0;
  --field: #CA5843;
  --field-glyph: #FFE9E4;
}

@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "wompland-blogwomp-dark";
  default: false;
  prefersdark: true;
  color-scheme: dark;
  --color-base-100: #1D1E20;
  --color-base-200: #25272A;
  --color-base-300: #303236;
  --color-base-content: #EEECE6;
  --color-primary: #E16C56;
  --color-primary-content: #141414;
  --color-secondary: #EEECE6;
  --color-secondary-content: #141414;
  --color-accent: #F2B53A;
  --color-accent-content: #141414;
  --color-neutral: #EEECE6;
  --color-neutral-content: #141414;
  --color-info: #B8C3CA;
  --color-info-content: #141414;
  --color-success: #6CC38A;
  --color-success-content: #141414;
  --color-warning: #F2B53A;
  --color-warning-content: #141414;
  --color-error: #FF7B6B;
  --color-error-content: #141414;
  --muted: #A9A69E;
  --radius-selector: 0rem;
  --radius-field: 0rem;
  --radius-box: 0rem;
  --size-selector: 0.25rem;
  --size-field: 0.25rem;
  --border: 2px;
  --depth: 0;
  --noise: 0;
  --field: #CA5843;
  --field-glyph: #FFE9E4;
}

/* Inactive tabs use the theme's muted color so they pass 4.5:1. */
.tabs > .tab:not(:hover, .tab-active, [aria-selected="true"], [aria-current]:not([aria-current="false"], [aria-current=""]), .tab-disabled, [disabled]) { color: var(--muted); }
```

Full setup, the logo swap for light and dark, and the usage rules: [How to apply a brand](https://brand.wompland.com/usage.md).

# riverWomp brand guide

A Womp, part of the [WompLand family](https://brand.wompland.com/index.md). Cornflower field, pale glyph. Themes `wompland-riverwomp-light` and `wompland-riverwomp-dark`.

**Icon.** A river of news: headlines flow down the page, newest first, in batches by source. Each dot starts a new source; the bars beside and below it are its headlines.

Visual version: https://brand.wompland.com/toolkit/brand.html?brand=riverwomp

## Logo files

Every file is generated from the brand data. The names in the SVGs are outlined paths, so logos need no font installed.

# wikiWomp brand guide

A Womp, part of the [WompLand family](https://brand.wompland.com/index.md). Teal field, pale glyph. Themes `wompland-wikiwomp-light` and `wompland-wikiwomp-dark`.

**Icon.** A link target: square brackets around a page block, the way a wiki link wraps the page it points to.

Visual version: https://brand.wompland.com/toolkit/brand.html?brand=wikiwomp

| PNG 512 | 512 × 512, web app manifest. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/icon-512.png |
| DaisyUI themes | Light and dark theme blocks. | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/daisyui-theme.css |
| Brand data | Source, colors, theme tokens and asset paths (JSON). | https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/brand.json |

## On light and dark

- Light ground: `horizontal.svg` / `stacked.svg`. Dark ground: the `-reverse` versions. The tile never changes; only the name switches from ink to paper.
- Keep 2 modules (2/9 of the tile) clear on every side.
- Minimum sizes: horizontal lockup 120 px (30 mm); stacked lockup 72 px (20 mm); tile, full art 24 px (8 mm); tile, favicon art 16 px. Below 24 px, use the favicon art.

## Colors

The tile is the Teal field with its pale partner as the glyph. Fields are surfaces: text on a field is only ever large (22px bold), because the glyph partner is gated at 3:1, which is AA for large text only. Text in the brand color uses the theme primary, which is derived from the field until it reaches 4.5:1 on both page grounds.

| Role | Hex | OKLCH |
|---|---|---|
| Field (tile background) | `#00948C` | oklch(60.1% 0.104 188.1) |
| Pale (glyph) | `#D5F7F3` | oklch(95.1% 0.036 187.9) |
| Deep (partner) | `#00302D` | oklch(27.9% 0.048 188.2) |

Theme primary:

- **Light** (`wompland-wikiwomp-light`): primary `#007973`, primary-content `#FFFFFF`
- **Dark** (`wompland-wikiwomp-dark`): primary `#1E9F97`, primary-content `#141414`

### Contrast gate

All 42 checks pass, light and dark. Body text 7:1, muted text and every color on its content 4.5:1, primary as text 4.5:1, interface colors 3:1.

| Pair | Min | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|---|
| base-content on base100 | 7 | 18.42:1 Pass | 14.12:1 Pass |

## Install

Copy the files into the project's static folder, then add the favicons to `<head>`:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-touch-icon.png">
```

Save [`daisyui-theme.css`](https://brand.wompland.com/brands/wikiwomp/daisyui-theme.css) next to the main stylesheet and import it after DaisyUI (Tailwind v4 + DaisyUI 5):

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@plugin "daisyui" { themes: false; }
@import "./daisyui-theme.css";
```

The light theme is the default; the dark theme applies when the visitor prefers dark. Set `data-theme="wompland-wikiwomp-dark"` on `<html>` to force it. Or paste the theme blocks directly:

```css
/* wikiWomp DaisyUI themes, generated from brands/wikiwomp.json. Import this file (or paste all of it) after @plugin "daisyui". */

@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "wompland-wikiwomp-light";
  default: true;
  prefersdark: false;
  color-scheme: light;
  --color-base-100: #FFFFFF;
  --color-base-200: #F3F2EE;
  --color-base-300: #E4E2DB;
  --color-base-content: #141414;
  --color-primary: #007973;
  --color-primary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-secondary: #141414;
  --color-secondary-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-accent: #8F6400;
  --color-accent-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral: #141414;
  --color-neutral-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-info: #3E4A52;
  --color-info-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-success: #1D6B3A;
  --color-success-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-warning: #8F6400;
  --color-warning-content: #FFFFFF;
  --color-error: #B3261E;
  --color-error-content: #FFFFFF;
  --muted: #57554F;
  --radius-selector: 0rem;
  --radius-field: 0rem;
  --radius-box: 0rem;
  --size-selector: 0.25rem;
  --size-field: 0.25rem;
  --border: 2px;
  --depth: 0;
  --noise: 0;
  --field: #00948C;
  --field-glyph: #D5F7F3;
}

@plugin "daisyui/theme" {
  name: "wompland-wikiwomp-dark";
  default: false;
  prefersdark: true;
  color-scheme: dark;
  --color-base-100: #1D1E20;
  --color-base-200: #25272A;
  --color-base-300: #303236;
  --color-base-content: #EEECE6;
  --color-primary: #1E9F97;
  --color-primary-content: #141414;
  --color-secondary: #EEECE6;
  --color-secondary-content: #141414;
  --color-accent: #F2B53A;
  --color-accent-content: #141414;
  --color-neutral: #EEECE6;
  --color-neutral-content: #141414;
  --color-info: #B8C3CA;
  --color-info-content: #141414;
  --color-success: #6CC38A;
  --color-success-content: #141414;
  --color-warning: #F2B53A;
  --color-warning-content: #141414;
  --color-error: #FF7B6B;
  --color-error-content: #141414;
  --muted: #A9A69E;
  --radius-selector: 0rem;
  --radius-field: 0rem;
  --radius-box: 0rem;
  --size-selector: 0.25rem;
  --size-field: 0.25rem;
  --border: 2px;
  --depth: 0;
  --noise: 0;
  --field: #00948C;
  --field-glyph: #D5F7F3;
}

/* Inactive tabs use the theme's muted color so they pass 4.5:1. */
.tabs > .tab:not(:hover, .tab-active, [aria-selected="true"], [aria-current]:not([aria-current="false"], [aria-current=""]), .tab-disabled, [disabled]) { color: var(--muted); }
```

Full setup, the logo swap for light and dark, and the usage rules: [How to apply a brand](https://brand.wompland.com/usage.md).
